Total$17.72M$15.72M$2.00M$6.96M+$1.88M+14.4%+$4.96M+28.0%
Method. Total P&L = MV now − (additions − withdrawals), external cash transfers only (from the 3R transaction reports; in-kind transfer to Antarras is not a flow). P&L % is on total additions; Ann. is the money-weighted IRR. YTD = MV now − MV at 31.12.2025 − net flows since (approx.: start value rebuilt from transactions and 31.12.2025 closes, ±2%); % = Modified Dietz, GEM to its Oct-2026 liquidation. TWR = time-weighted return: value rebuilt from the transactions just before every flow, sub-period returns chained, last period to the current MV (updates on every refresh while there are no new flows); GEM stops at liquidation; TWR ann. compounds it from inception; IRR ann. is the money-weighted return. Initial = first cash inflow. Withdrawals include the GEM liquidation transfers (Oct-2026) and the EVO withdrawal (Jul-2026); US Equity income received $0.8M new money in Aug-2026. Cash returned from the old JPM accounts after the transfer (dividends, residual cash) counts as income, not as a flow. GEM inception = first cash inflow (mandate opened ~1 month earlier).
